mapper.select: SELECT title_id, title_type, original_title, original_language, release_date, runtime_min, status, is_animation AS animation, popularity, vote_average, vote_count, poster_path, meta_version FROM content_title WHERE title_id = #{titleId} AND status <> 'DELETED'

SELECT t.title_id, t.title_type, COALESCE(l.local_title, t.original_title) AS display_title, t.original_title, t.release_date, t.status, t.is_animation AS animation, t.vote_average, t.poster_path, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_season s WHERE s.title_id = t.title_id) AS season_count, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(e.provider ORDER BY e.provider) FROM content_external_id e WHERE e.entity_type = 'TITLE' AND e.entity_id = t.title_id) AS providers, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(g.name_ko ORDER BY g.genre_code) FROM content_title_genre tg JOIN content_genre g ON g.genre_code = tg.genre_code WHERE tg.title_id = t.title_id) AS genres FROM content_title t LEFT JOIN content_localization l ON l.title_id = t.title_id AND l.lang_code = #{lang}
ORDER BY t.release_date IS NULL, t.release_date, t.title_id
ORDER BY display_title, t.title_id
ORDER BY t.vote_average IS NULL, t.vote_average DESC, t.title_id DESC
ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.title_id DESC
ORDER BY t.release_date DESC, t.title_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT g.genre_code, g.name_ko, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_title_genre tg JOIN content_title t ON t.title_id = tg.title_id AND t.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE tg.genre_code = g.genre_code) AS title_count FROM content_genre g ORDER BY g.name_ko
SELECT lang_code, local_title, overview, source FROM content_localization WHERE title_id = #{titleId} ORDER BY lang_code
SELECT provider, external_id, match_method, verified FROM content_external_id WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} ORDER BY provider

SELECT e.entity_id FROM content_external_id e JOIN content_title t ON t.title_id = e.entity_id AND t.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE e.entity_type = 'TITLE' AND e.provider = #{provider} AND e.external_id = #{externalId}
SELECT region_code, release_date, age_rating, source FROM content_title_region WHERE title_id = #{titleId} ORDER BY region_code
SELECT genre_code FROM content_title_genre WHERE title_id = #{titleId} ORDER BY genre_code
SELECT country_code FROM content_title_country WHERE title_id = #{titleId} ORDER BY country_code

SELECT s.season_id, s.season_no, s.season_name, s.air_date, s.episode_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_episode e WHERE e.season_id = s.season_id) AS loaded_episodes FROM content_season s WHERE s.title_id = #{titleId} ORDER BY s.season_no

SELECT p.person_id, p.person_name, c.role_type, c.character_name, c.credit_order, p.name_only FROM content_credit c JOIN content_person p ON p.person_id = c.person_id WHERE c.title_id = #{titleId} ORDER BY FIELD(c.role_type, 'DIRECTOR', 'CREATOR', 'WRITER', 'CAST'), c.credit_order
mapper.update: {call sp_external_id_cud( #{operation, mode=IN, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{worker, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workip, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{entityType, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{entityId, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{provider, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{externalId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rtnCod, mode=INOUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errMsg, mode=INOUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )}

{call sp_localization_cud( #{operation, mode=IN, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{worker, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workip, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{titleId, mode=IN, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{langCode, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{localTitle, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{overview, mode=IN, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{rtnCod, mode=INOUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errMsg, mode=INOUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )}
